After a lot of work, testing, and community feedback, I'm happy to share what I consider one of my most refined designs so far: the **Nintendo Switch 2 Travel Case - Ultimate Edition**.

This new version has been redesigned deeply to be more durable, easier to assemble, and accessible to as many makers as possible.

## What's New in Ultimate Edition?

### Fully Screwless Assembly

One of the biggest improvements is the complete removal of screws.

The entire case now uses integrated locking tabs and slot systems, eliminating the need for additional hardware.

**Benefits:**

- No screws to buy or source
- Faster and easier assembly
- No risk of overtightening screws and damaging printed parts
- Cleaner and more reliable construction

### Improved Game Cartridge Retention System

The cartridge holders has been completely redesigned.

The original design relied on the tension of flexible plastic tabs to keep cartridges in place. Over time, PLA can slowly deform, reducing the holding force.

The new system uses two small locking tabs that mechanically retain each cartridge, ensuring secure storage even after long-term use.

No more loose cartridges!

### Increased Structural Strength

I reviewed and reinforced several attachment points throughout the design to improve overall durability and robustness.

### New Print-in-Place Handle Lid

Following many requests from users of the XXL version, I created a new **print-in-place lid with an integrated handle**.

This lid offers:

- Comfortable carrying handle
- No assembly required
- Full compatibility with the existing attachment system

The only trade-off is storage capacity:

- Handle lid: **12 game cartridges**
- Standard lids: **24 game cartridges**

## Normal and XXL Versions Unified

The previous Normal and XXL versions have now been merged into a single project.

Print profiles are organized according to the different lid designs.

### Standard Profiles Include

Each standard profile contains:

- One lid design
- The base
- A plate containing all attachment components:
  - Switch 2 retaining bar
  - 2 lid locking clips
  - 2 wrist-strap holders

Assembly is simple and requires no tools.

### 1\. Install the Wrist-Strap Holders

Insert one holder on each side of the case.

These parts are optional and can be omitted if you don't use wrist straps.

### 2\. Install the Switch Retaining Bar

Insert the retaining bar into the dedicated slot inside the base.

### 3\. Install the Lid Locking Clips

Insert one side of the clip into its slot first, then gently slide the other side into place.

Repeat for the second clip.

### 4\. Attach the Lid to the Base

The lid uses the same installation principle as the clips.

Start by engaging one side, then progressively work the opposite side into the base slots.

A gentle opening and closing motion during installation can help the lid slide into place more easily.

### XXL Profile Includes

- XXL base
- Nintendo Switch 2 support insert
- Print-in-place handle lid
- Pro Controller insert
- Divider insert

The handle lid can be replaced by any standard lid since they all use the exact same attachment system.

### XXL Accessories

#### Pro Controller Insert

Designed to securely hold a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.

For even better retention, you can optionally add an elastic band.

You can install up to **two controller inserts** inside the XXL base simultaneously.

#### Divider Insert

Allows better organization of accessories.

Up to **three dividers** can be installed inside the XXL base.
